import json,pathlib,importlib.util
from src.tools.t01_partition import audited_result
from src.tools.g01_collect_parallel import benchmark_stage,required_timeout
r=pathlib.Path.cwd(); scenes=['FloorPlan1','FloorPlan7','FloorPlan203','FloorPlan204','FloorPlan301','FloorPlan401'];concurrency=6
analysis,analysis_ref=audited_result(r/'results/diag_g01_concurrency_analysis_01.json');assert analysis['_meta']['exit_code']==0
for n in ('g01_construction_metadata_cpu_01','g01_construction_metadata_regression_01'):
 test,_=audited_result(r/'results'/f'{n}.json');assert test['_meta']['exit_code']==0 and test['metrics']['command_exit_code']==0
proof=benchmark_stage(r/'results/gen_train_concurrency_s15_02.json',concurrency)
timeout=required_timeout(scenes,concurrency);wall=timeout+30;assert timeout==1600 and wall==1630
mod=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('phase',r/'scripts/pbs/submit_phase.py');phase=importlib.util.module_from_spec(mod);mod.loader.exec_module(phase);budget=phase.budget_state(r)
assert budget['accounted_or_reserved_by_subbudget']['G01']+wall/3600<=20 and budget['accounted_or_reserved_total']+wall/3600<=60
d={'name':'gen_train_metadata_revalidate_01','purpose':'one bounded metadata-retention and six-lane native-stability revalidation; not a full pool commitment','scenes':scenes,'concurrency':concurrency,'gpus':1,'cpu_cores':12,'maximum_unity_instances':8,'wall_seconds':wall,'timeout_seconds':timeout,'benchmark':proof,'analysis':analysis_ref,'code_fix_commit':'53865bf','budget_before':budget['accounted_or_reserved_by_subbudget'],'requested_ceiling_gpu_hours':wall/3600,'policy':'unchanged thresholds/fixed labels/FOV60/training-only scenes; originals and failed runs preserved; independent acceptance required before qualified counts'}
p=r/'logs/review/diag_g01_metadata_revalidation_plan_01';p.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
with (p/'plan.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(d,f,sort_keys=True,indent=2);f.write('\n')
note='\n### Bounded post-fix G01 revalidation plan\n\nSix lanes had the highest measured source-candidate throughput but one native action timeout, so stability is not established. The measured balanced-target extrapolation exceeds the approved20GPUh G01 cap; no full-scale commitment is made. Before expanding, repeat only the same six training scenes after the original-metadata retention fix, with full1200s/scene grants, at most8 Unity processes and oneGPU/12CPU. Requested1630s (0.4527777777777778GPUh), including bounded authentication/render gate/cleanup. This is a limited implementation and stability revalidation within the existing cap; no thresholds or task structure change, and old evidence stays invalid where missing. Source candidates still require independent verification and T02 filtering. Plan: logs/review/diag_g01_metadata_revalidation_plan_01/plan.json.\n'
with (r/'STATUS.md').open('a') as f:f.write(note)
print('G01_METADATA_REVALIDATION_PLAN: '+json.dumps(d,sort_keys=True))
